title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: the by-name /meta read answers a disabled package's non-object item as absent, as the list omits it
body:
Part of #24210 (it covers the by-name read and the dispatcher's doors; the doors listed under "Stopped at the fence" stay open and are why this does not close the card)

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Implements triage 6239967422 on #24210 (absence for a non-object type; `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` stays the object answer) under claim 6240246860, dispatched by the `domain:engine` seat 1 (`session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`). Rework round: seat ruling 6241893667 under the re-declared claim 6241900550 (items 4 and 5 below; Q1, Q2 and Q4 settled A).

## What changed

Disabling a package already took its items out of every `GET /meta/:type` list. The by-name read still served them. It now answers them the way it answers a name with nothing behind it.

1. **`getMetaItem`** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`). After the body read (`readMetaItem`, unchanged), an item of any type except `object` and `package` whose `_packageId` names a disabled package is answered as absent:
   - the active read and `previewDrafts` serve no `item`, and both transports answer that `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, byte for byte the answer for a missing name;
   - the strict draft read throws the missing draft's `404 NO_DRAFT` (one constructor, `noPendingDraftError`, for both);
   - a flow's `registration` is dropped with the item;
   - the protection envelope (`lock`, `editable`, `deletable`, `version` and the rest) stays. It reports the write doors' verdicts about the address, and a disable does not change how the lock gate judges a save there. The CLI ownership ceremony gates its own raw-SQL writes on exactly these fields (`lock.verdict`), so this keeps a locked item locked for it.
2. **One predicate (H1).** `isItemOfDisabledPackage(registry, item)` is the list read's filter (`readFlattenedMetaItems`) and the by-name read's check. Both ask `registry.isPackageDisabled(item._packageId)` of the item the read resolved, so they hide the same items. There is no new public method, spec key or error code.
3. **The dispatcher** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`, cross-lane, declared to `domain:cli`). Four doors read past the protocol and served a disabled package's object or item:
   - `/meta/object/NAME/state/FIELD` and the legacy one-segment `/meta/NAME` exit read `registry.getObject`. Both now ask `disabledObjectAnswer` first, which answers the protocol's own `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`;
   - `/meta/:type/:name/published` swallowed the layered read's refusal and fell through to the published snapshot. `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` is now the answer, as on `RestServer`'s `/published`;
   - the item read of a non-object type fell back to the metadata service when the protocol served no item. The service knows nothing of a disable, so the fallback now skips an item whose `_packageId` names a disabled package (`isServiceItemOfDisabledPackage`, the same predicate).

4. **`fetchCurrentMetaDocument`** (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, the class member only, nothing inside `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`; ruling item 1). It is the current document the `/history`, `/audit` and `/diff` doors' per-caller gate judges. With item 1 a disabled package's item read as "no current document", so those doors served events, and a view's or dashboard's diff, past the gate. When the plain read serves no item but the layered read (which keeps serving every layer) still resolves one, the member now throws the plain read's absence, `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, which the doors' own catch renders. An item that is really gone (every layer null, such as a deleted item) keeps today's answer.
5. **`readServedPackageBinding`** (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-catalog-echo.ts`, that function only; ruling item 2). It is a resolution read, so it reads the binding off the protection envelope's declared `packageId` (the served document's `_packageId`, kept when the item is withheld) instead of `item._packageId`. A disabled package's permission set or position echoes owned, and stays owned after a re-enable. No new public method, no enforcement change.

`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` is not edited.

## Premise: the callers of a by-name read of a non-object item

Measured before any edit. "Today" is `origin/main` `b7f29ddfe`; "after" is this branch. The case is an item of a disabled package. objectui is read at `origin/main` `54e79f9` (read-only clone). No caller has to tell "disabled" from "missing", and none must be served the item, so absence holds.

| Call site | What it does | Today | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| objectui `data-objectstack` `probeMetaItemAccess` and `getAppAccessVerdict` (via `AppContent.tsx`, `useMetaItemRefusal.ts`) | explains why an app, dashboard or view in the URL is not in the list | `granted`, and `AppContent` shows the neutral "App not available" screen: its own comment names this case, "the by-name route served the app while the refreshed list still does not carry it" | `not_found`: "This app can't be opened". Its verdict set has no disabled arm; denied stays denied |
| objectui `data-objectstack` `getApp`, `getPage`, `getView`, the batch `getItem(category, …)` | render-time reads | served | `null` (absence), the face a missing item gets |
| objectui `MetadataProvider.getItem(type, name)`, `useActionModal` (`page`), `FormPage.loadInternalForm` (`view`), `DocPage` / `DocsSlug` (`doc`) | render the item | served | not found. Each uses the item, and the list already omits it |
| objectui `DraftChangesPanel` (`/meta/TYPE/NAME` and `?state=draft`) | diff a pending draft against its published side | both sides served | both `404`, read as `null` sides. Not a reader that must be served: see Acceptance notes on `_drafts` |
| objectui `PackagesPage`, `PackagedAutomationPage`, `PackagedActionsSection` (Studio package screens, re-enable) | `/api/v1/packages`, `_drafts`, lists | not a by-name reader | unchanged. `package` is never hidden |
| objectui editors on `/layers` (`ResourceEditPage`, `EmbeddedItemEditor`, `PermissionMatrixEditor`, `LayeredDiff`) | layered view | served | unchanged here (`/layers` is a stopped door); every entry point lists first |
| `packages/cli` ownership ceremony `lock.verdict` (`organization-ownership.ts`), `PRESENTATIONAL_TYPES` = view, dashboard, report, translation, email_template | gates raw-SQL writes on `editable` / `lock` | the item's real verdict | the same verdict: the envelope is kept (pinned: "the protection envelope stays") |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security` `readServedPackageBinding` (`security-catalog-echo.ts`), `permission` / `position` | reads the package that owns a stored overlay, for an environment-kernel echo | the package id | the package id, read off the kept envelope (item 5; pinned owned through disable and re-enable). `getMetaItemLayered`, which decides whether the echo exists, is not touched |
| `packages/rest` `fetchCurrentMetaDocument` (`/history`, `/audit`, `/diff`) | the current document the per-caller gate judges | the item | absence: the doors answer `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` (item 4; measured below) |
| `packages/rest` import mapping, `service-automation` connector pull (`mapping`) | use the mapping | served | not found. Each uses the item |
| `packages/runtime` `applyPublishedSeeds`, `service-analytics` seed draft probe (`seed`) | apply a seed / find a pending seed draft | served | not found / `NO_DRAFT` (already caught). The seed's objects are refused by the data plane anyway |
| `packages/core` import runner, `plugin-auth` admin user import, `rest` data-action routes | read `type: 'object'` only | unchanged by this PR | unchanged |

## Doors, measured over HTTP

**REST:** `pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh` (real socket), before at `b7f29ddfe`, after at this branch with a full `pnpm build` (76/76). **Dispatcher:** the real store (`SqliteWasmDriver`) and the real protocol (`ObjectQLPlugin`) under `createHonoApp`, driven through its fetch handler, the `packages/qa/http-conformance` harness shape (scratch script, not committed). Both against a writable package `app.probe-24210` holding object `probe_gadget`, app, page, dashboard, flow and view.

| Request, package disabled | REST before | REST after | Dispatcher before | Dispatcher after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /meta/TYPE` contains the item (6 types) | no | no | no | no |
| `GET /meta/TYPE/NAME`, app, page, dashboard, flow, view | 200, served | **404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`**, = missing name | 200, served | **404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`**, = missing name |
| `GET /meta/TYPE/NAME?preview=draft`, same six | 200, served | **404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`** | 200, served | **404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`** |
| `GET /meta/TYPE/NAME?state=draft`, same six | 404 `NO_DRAFT` | 404 `NO_DRAFT` | 404 `NO_DRAFT` | 404 `NO_DRAFT` |
| `GET /meta/TYPE/NAME?layers=true` / `/layers`, same six | 200, served | 200, served (stopped) | 200, served | 200, served (stopped) |
| `GET /meta/TYPE/NAME/published`, same six | 200, served | 200, served (stopped) | 200, served | 200, served (stopped) |
| `GET /meta/object/probe_gadget/published` | 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` | 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` (snapshot fall-through; a host with a metadata service serves the snapshot) | **404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`** |
| `GET /meta/object/probe_gadget/state/status?from=open` | 200, served | 200, served (stopped) | 200, served | **404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`** |
| `GET /meta/probe_gadget` (one segment) | 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` (the list route) | 400 | 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`, enabled and disabled alike | 400 |
| `GET /meta/object/probe_gadget`, `/data/probe_gadget` | 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` | unchanged | 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` | unchanged |
| control: another package's object, by name and `/state` | 200 | 200 | 200 | 200 |

Byte equality: on REST the disabled item and a missing name both answer `{"error":{"code":"RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND","message":"Metadata item not found or access denied."}}`; on the dispatcher both answer `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found","httpStatus":404}}`. The enabled readings after are identical to the enabled readings before on both transports, and re-enabling restores every row. The REST server log carried 0 `failing open` warnings.

## Mechanism hypotheses (measured)

- **H1, one predicate: holds.** Every layer the by-name read serves carries the owning package as `_packageId` on the resolved item: the stored row's `package_id` (grafted in `readMetaItem`), the registry item (stamped by `registerItem`), the artifact envelope. The list filter reads the same field off its merged items, so one helper serves both.
- **H2, absence without a new path: holds.** The missing name's exit is an item-less envelope, and both transports judge absence on `item == null` (`createMetaItemAnswer` on REST, the `data?.item != null` hit test on the dispatcher); the cached arm throws `metadataItemNotFoundError` on a falsy item, and REST maps both to `sendMetaItemAbsent`. The dispatcher half needed the service-fallback guard above, because its miss fell through to the metadata service.
- **H3, `/published`: half holds.** For objects, REST already re-throws the layered refusal (`typeof status === 'number'`), measured 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` before any edit; the dispatcher's blanket catch is now narrowed in `meta.ts`. For non-object types the producer side cannot carry it: see below.
- **H4, the dispatcher's two doors: half holds.** `/state/FIELD` reads the registry directly and served the object; closed. The one-segment `/meta/NAME` legacy exit is not reachable over HTTP on a real composition: `refuseUnknownMetaListType` answers 400 first, enabled and disabled alike. It is reachable only on a host whose protocol declares no type set; closed in code and pinned there.

## Stopped at the fence (open on #24210 for a follow-up dispatch after this PR lands; #23050's move series is no longer in flight, notice 6243012505)

Ruling 6241893667 items 3, 4 and 6: these stay on the card, on the door side, both transports together, after slice 13e.

1. **`?layers=true`, `/layers` and `/published` for a non-object item, both transports.** Producer `getMetaItemLayered` keeps serving its resolution reader, the security catalog echo (`echoSecurityCatalogMutation`, `echoStoredSecurityCatalogOverlays`), which turns a stored `permission` / `position` overlay into what an environment kernel enforces; absence there would be an enforcement change. The doors close on the door side (`rest-server.ts`'s layered and `/published` handlers inside `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, and `meta.ts`'s twins). `/published`'s non-object fall-through is also `MetadataManager.getPublished` (`packages/metadata`), whose document carries no `_packageId`.
2. **REST `/meta/object/NAME/state/FIELD`, the interim transport split.** REST's state route reads `ql.registry.getObject(name)` directly and serves a disabled package's object (measured 200 after this PR); the dispatcher twin answers 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`. The one-door split holds until the REST half lands with item 1.
3. **`GET /meta/_drafts`** still lists a disabled package's drafts while the by-name draft read answers `NO_DRAFT` for them: another door of the same rule, joining item 1's follow-up.

## The event and diff doors, measured over HTTP (item 4)

`pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh`, real socket, full build after merging `origin/main`. "Before" is this branch without item 4 (head `8946a02d4`, the merge on top of `b2f89e8f`); "after" is `232339ab8`. A writable package `app.gate-24210` holds dashboard `gate_dash` and app `gate_app`, each saved twice, each with `requiredPermissions: ['gate_24210_cap']`; dashboard `gate_gone` was saved and deleted.

- **Gated caller:** the seeded admin. It holds `studio.access` / `manage_metadata`, so the three doors admit it, and not `gate_24210_cap`, so the item's own gate refuses it the item whole: the caller the bypass reaches.
- **Member caller:** a user created by `POST /auth/admin/create-user` (no capabilities). The doors' capability gate refuses it first on every row: `403 FORBIDDEN` on `/history`, `/audit`, `/diff`, enabled and disabled, before and after.

| Gated caller, package state | Request | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| enabled | `GET /meta/dashboard/gate_dash` and `/meta/app/gate_app` | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| enabled | `/history`, `/audit`, `/diff` of both | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| disabled | `GET /meta/dashboard/gate_dash` and `/meta/app/gate_app` | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` |
| disabled | `/meta/dashboard/gate_dash/history` | **200, the events** | **404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`** |
| disabled | `/meta/dashboard/gate_dash/audit` | **200, the audit trail** | **404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`** |
| disabled | `/meta/dashboard/gate_dash/diff` | **200, the diff** (`label` v1 to v2) | **404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`** |
| disabled | `/meta/app/gate_app/history`, `/audit` | **200, the events** | **404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`** |
| disabled | `/meta/app/gate_app/diff` | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` |
| deleted `gate_gone` | `/history`, `/diff` | 200 (events; empty diff) | 200 (unchanged) |
| re-enabled | every row | as enabled | as enabled |

Envelope position: the plain read answers `{"error":{"code":"RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND","message":"Metadata item not found or access denied."}}`; the event and diff doors now answer status 404 and code `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` in the classification door's flat shape, `{"error":"Metadata item not found or access denied.","code":"RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND"}`, because the member throws and the doors' catch (`handleRouteError`) renders it. The app `/diff` row, which answered the nested body before through the door's own absent check, now answers the flat one. A byte-identical nested body needs the door side (`eventDoorRefusal` and the `/diff` branch), outside this fence.

## Pins

- `packages/objectql/src/package-disable-enforcement.test.ts`, the #7557 pin. `READERS` gains four app rows (`getMetaItem` active, plural, `state: 'draft'`, `previewDrafts`) and two generated rows per type `MetadataTypeSchema` declares except `object` (27 types today; the schema does not list `package`): listing and by-name, so a new type gets its rows with nothing to write. The seed registers one item of every such type per package, as a code package registers it, plus a pending app draft. New cases: absence equals the missing name on every type (no `item`, no `registration`, and `NO_DRAFT` with the missing draft's exact message); the control, another package's item of every type still listed and served by name; the envelope is kept byte for byte apart from `item`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts` (new), through `HttpDispatcher.dispatch`: `/state/FIELD` and the one-segment exit refuse `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` and never ask `registry.getObject` for the name; `/published` answers the refusal and never asks `getPublished`; the service fallback's answer for a disabled package's page is byte-identical to a missing name's; a control for each.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-alternate-door-read-gates.test.ts`: a gated dashboard and app the plain read withholds while their layers resolve, driven with a caller the item's own gate refuses: `/history`, `/audit`, `/diff` answer 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` (403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` while enabled), no secret in the body, and `historyMetaItem` / `auditMetaItem` / `diffMetaItem` never called. The existing "nothing behind the name" case now says so on both reads (its layered double served the doc), so it still pins the deleted item's answer: `/diff` absent, `/history` its events.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-catalog-echo.test.ts`: a disabled package's set echoes owned (by-name item withheld, anti-vacuity), stays owned after the re-enable, and re-echoes owned; the `stubProtocol` double now answers the envelope's `packageId` as the protocol's `servedLockState` does.
- Pin sweep: `git grep` of `disablePackage(`, `/disable`, `isPackageDisabled` and the `NO_DRAFT` sentence across every test: no existing pin asserts a disabled package's non-object item is served by name, so nothing flips; the suites of every package with a hit were run (below).

## Verification (head `232339ab8`, after merging `origin/main` at `b9ac35cbf`)

The head is now `ec7d6af8b`, one commit later. It changes only the `BY_NAME_TYPES` filter line and its docblock in `package-disable-enforcement.test.ts` (TS2367). At `ec7d6af8b`, the typecheck scripts (`tsc` plus `check:test-typecheck`) of `objectql`, `metadata-protocol`, `runtime`, `rest` and `plugin-security` each exit 0, and the pin is 15/15.

- Tests, full suites at this head: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 244 files / 20641 passed (3 skipped files); `@objectstack/objectql` 438 / 8249 passed; `@objectstack/runtime` 413 / 7095 passed; `@objectstack/rest` 299 / 6284 passed (339 skipped); `@objectstack/plugin-security` 188 / 3737 passed (45 skipped).
- Typecheck clean: `metadata-protocol`, `runtime`, `rest`, `plugin-security`. Full `pnpm build` 76/76 after the merge.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derived 73 commands at `232339ab8`; all 73 exited 0 (the clone is unshallow now, so the two shallow-clone refusals of the first round did not recur). `--ran` with exit codes: "73 derived, 73 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: exit 0.
- **Ablations**, one per changed tested behaviour, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with a `trap` restore proven by `blob == HEAD`:

Restored and rebuilt, marker back in `dist/index.js`: 15 / 15.
  - (b)–(e) in `meta.ts` (the suite imports `src`): the `/state` check, the one-segment check, the `/published` re-throw and the service-fallback guard, each removed alone, each turned exactly its own case red (1 failed / 6 passed); restored, 7 / 7.
  - (f) `fetchCurrentMetaDocument`'s throw disabled: only the new withheld-item case went red (1 failed / 426 passed); restored, 427 / 427.
  - (g) `readServedPackageBinding` back on `item._packageId`: only the new disabled-package echo case went red (1 failed / 18 passed); restored, 19 / 19.

## Acceptance notes

- `origin/main` was merged into the branch (`8946a02d4`, a merge commit; no rebase, no force-push), with no conflict.
- The member caller cannot reach the event and diff doors at all (their capability gate); the bypass reaches an author who lacks the item's own `requiredPermissions`, which is the gated caller measured above.
- No changeset for `@objectstack/objectql`: its diff is a test file, outside its published `files`.
